# ECMAScript reference corpus

Generated by tools/reference/generate-regex.mjs using Node v22.21.1 and Unicode 16.0. The node.json corpus contains 7,671 String.prototype.replace cases and 19 invalid pattern/flag cases. Inputs, formats and outputs use UTF-16 unit arrays to preserve lone surrogates through Go's JSON decoder. Final lastIndex is compared exactly.

The sibling legacy_fold.json embed is generated by the same script from single-unit JavaScript uppercase canonicalization. unicode_properties.json was moved unchanged from Validation and remains generated by generate-validation-unicode.mjs. Neither fixture normalization nor library execution uses a JavaScript runtime in Go.

Actual Powertools masking traversal and shared-expression state are checked separately in integration/maskingregex. See docs/REGEX.md for unsupported and unverified boundaries.
